ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Federal Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of federal fraud, including Medicare and Medicaid fraud, and follow the money to uncover potential connections to other federal investigations.
questions: What is the scope of federal fraud?
How do federal investigations impact states and local communities?
ideas.insight: By following the money and investigating federal fraud, we may uncover a larger pattern of corruption and abuse of power. This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable.
